notes.title: Fixed some issues (v0.8.7 patch notes)
notes.content: [p]Just some minor fixes for today:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug with graphical tearing in some of the UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed wording of Hard-Working Adventurers to make it clearer how it works for new players.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Fixed a critical bug (v0.8.6 patch notes)
notes.content: [p]Loading the game through the title screen used to prevent you from seeing any signs, meaning you couldn't build anything. This obviously hampered progress quite a bit in a town-building game. 🙃[/p][p][/p][p]This has now been fixed! Please let us know about any bugs you encounter via [url="https://discord.gg/Gjaqt9k53R"]Discord[/url].[/p]

notes.title: UI overhaul! (v0.8.5 patch notes)
notes.content: [p]It's been about two months since the last update. We've been hard at work on post-demo content, so the patch notes may [i]seem[/i] a bit light, but trust us when we say that the full game is going to be great! 🎉[/p][list][*][p]Overhauled the UI. The panels, tabs, and various elements should look a lot nicer now:[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204560/1d1107d5e289c26721a5460fd86ba9b43654a417.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Added custom character portraits for all NPCs (e.g. if you click the Garbage Slime, you'll now see this):[/p][list][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204560/41e999dab2d206434c2c0de3cd5fcf652b20bef7.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Loot now flies from the portal into the warehouse rather than teleporting there.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you want to playtest [i]all[/i] of the changes we've been making, please join us in [url="https://discord.gg/Gjaqt9k53R"]the Skeleseller Discord[/url]![/p]

notes.title: Lots of polish! (v0.8.3 patch notes)
notes.content: [p]Whew, it's been almost a month since the last update...! We've been working hard on Skeleseller, but the focus has shifted to getting ready for launch, meaning the demo won't be getting very many updates. Still, there's a slew of changes we think you'll love:[/p][list][*][p]Elite battles now have custom styling! The border is made of bones with snakes wrapped around them. This should more clearly indicate to new players that elite battles are special (more than just "why is this battle window big all of a sudden?").[/p][/*][*][p]The intro now has a poisonous snake instead of a poisonous slime. This was for consistency with the [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QL94lgcawtI"]Skelerap[/url]. 👀[/p][/*][*][p]New locations are now unlocked with explicit buttons on the locations themselves rather than a dedicated "Upgrade portal" button. This allows the battle map to take up even more space in the UI.[/p][list][*][p]The "Unlock" button flashes green to make it stand out more.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The Guildmaster's hiring dialogs have been consolidated. Gil used to ask if you want to pay to hire a new adventurer, then he would present you with the choices separately. Now, you can see the choices without paying money, and the act of choosing [i]is[/i] the purchase.[/p][/*][*][p]All NPCs are now corporeal and will cast shadows correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Very slightly buffed the Paladin.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved CPU performance of the entire game. There was a frequent function call that we rewrote to be [i]much[/i] faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved VRAM usage slightly (battle windows no longer have a need to be upscaled).[/p][/*][*][p]Text in the town will no longer cover battle windows.[/p][/*][*][p]The tip about "keep battling to grow Skeletown" now automatically hides after only 2 battles (it used to be 3, causing many players to manually dismiss it).[/p][/*][*][p]Some brown mushrooms around town are now special in some way...[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Changes to skills (v0.8.2 patch notes)
notes.content: [p]The biggest changes in this patch have to do with [b]skills[/b]:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204560/98390a7bcc5592282cee6fe52bf482892de849fb.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]You now unlock two skills upon hitting level 2, that way you have a choice of where to put your first skill point.[/p][/*][*][p]Skills that haven't been unlocked now show in the skill area so that you can tell how many you [i]will[/i] get.[/p][/*][*][p]The tooltips for skills tell you what level you get the skill at and how to level up (so it will tell you to beat an elite enemy → build the farm → use Wisdom Sludge).[/p][/*][/list][p]This should add clarity and choice for players, so let us know what you think! 😁[/p][p][/p][p]There are also some minor improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a sprite-bleeding issue that could happen on the coin and brain icons.[/p][/*][*][p]The fishing pond's tooltip now indicates that you can click the pond to directly open the battle map.[/p][/*][*][p]The tip system will no longer show the tips about building the armor or weapon shops if you already have them.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Unspent-skill-point indicator—FINALLY! (v0.8.1 patch notes)
notes.content: [p]See the "!" on the Rogue and Mage? That means... you've got skill points to spend! This has been a thorn in many players' sides for a while, and now hopefully no one ever has to wonder about spending skill points again.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204560/ca09088dc332487d8867f50b26106fe05352487e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Other changes include:[/p][list][*][p]Slightly increased the leveling rate early on (lower sludge costs and one farm perk is 5G cheaper)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Discord button to the title screen. Feel free to contact us there with feedback![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some small bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Made some small improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New update (v0.8.0) - B I G battles ⚔️
notes.content: [p]The biggest change is that battle windows can now be much larger than they used to be! They can be smaller, too, of course:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204560/52f96866baaa9d9e1c12aaf52ec7f5f5767cfc3d.gif"][/img][/p][p]The other big change is that there's a new perk at the Garbage Slime to address a common pain point:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204560/bd59a766b7d34ca39221e37b23511ac8dd580ba0.png"][/img][/p][p]Beyond that, there were ~4 bug fixes that aren't worth detailing. Have fun skellin' and sellin'![/p]

notes.title: Skeleseller update - animated items when purchasing! (v0.7.17 patch notes)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204560/ee46fda86169f92dc043db69d8214204e0f17b3c.gif[/img]

The most important changes in this patch are:
[list]
[*]Items are now animated when customers buy them.
[*]You can no longer open dialogs from NPCs or perks boards while holding an item. This should prevent people from seeing the slimes' dialogs all the time. 😛
[*]Before being able to start [i]any[/i] battle, your adventurers will regenerate to full life. This used to only be the case when auto-battling, which meant people could get into new battles at, say, 50% life, and then almost certainly lose those battles.
[*]Items can now stack on the ground.
[*]You can now click the fishing pond itself to open the battle map directly to the pond, allowing you to fish more easily.
[*]Phantom items will no longer spawn! This bug took ~8 months to solve. It was caused by clicking an item on the same frame that a worker picked it up and resulted in an item graphic getting stuck in the town that you couldn't click and that workers couldn't pick up.
[/list]
There were some other small changes that went into this to improve the quality of life while playing Skeleseller.

UPDATE (~17 hours later, v0.7.18): fixed a bug with regeneration after loading from a save file.

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.16 patch notes
notes.content:
Lots of improvements! Let's start with the most important ones:
[list]
[*]Changed how regeneration works. Prior to this change, the regeneration time after battle was based on the party member with the lowest life. This meant that if even a single party member died, you'd have to wait ~14 seconds until the next battle. With the new system, the time is based on the average life lost. E.g. if you have two party members and the battle ends with one dead and one at full health, the regeneration time will be cut in half. This should result in battles feeling like they're running faster, but each individual battle should probably only save 1-5 seconds.
[*]Fixed Spicy Cooking. It was actually detrimental to unlock at first and it wasn't until level 3 that it was marginally good. Now, all values are what they say they should be.
[*]Fixed Shield Bash. It was also detrimental in that it was [i]increasing[/i] the damage that the Paladin would take. 🤦‍♂️
[*]Added messages about invalid item destinations. E.g. if you try to drag a potion to the extractor and the farm is full, it will now tell you that. This should help new players.
[*]Fixed the tip about having multiple concurrent battles. New players frequently weren't aware that this was a feature, and it's because the tip that shows in the game about this had the wrong condition for showing.
[/list]

Next up, the slightly less important changes:
[list]
[*] Highlighted mana red when you don't have enough to cast a spell.
[*] Allowed for dragging battle windows from any portion of them, not just the title bar.
[*] Fixed a bug where text in the town would be positioned weirdly sometimes.
[*] Added a sound effect when losing a battle.
[*] Delayed tips after beating elites so that you aren't overwhelmed by everything that's happening (a banner shows up when you beat elites, and the tip would sometimes show up at exactly the same time).
[/list]

Finally, there are a handful of bug fixes that aren't worth detailing here. Hope you enjoy the new version! 😁

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.15 patch notes
notes.content:
Some big changes in this patch! 🎉
[list]
[*]Revamped every item graphic in the game! They now fit the Skeleseller style.
[*]Skills are now unlocked automatically rather than by spending gold. You get a new one every even-numbered level until you're at 7 skills.
[*]Fixed an issue where some shops were preferred over other shops. Namely, the armor shop should now see customers buying from it more frequently.
[/list]

And then the usual set of minor changes:
[list]
[*]Looped music on the title screen. Streamers especially would linger on the title screen for long enough that they would be surprised when the music ended.
[*]Hopefully fixed an issue where the perks UI would resize vertically due to the appearance/disappearance of a "●" character.
[*]Fixed a bug where the giant arrow telling you to open the battle map in the tutorial wouldn't show again if you closed the battle map without starting a battle.
[*]Applied minor balance tweaks: Paladin healing is up, Paladin Shield Bash has a lower cooldown, volcano bats do 5% less damage, and lowered the cost of a farming perk.
[*]Fixed a bug in the camera-panning code where you would hold WASD and open the battle map and it would still pan the town camera.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.14 patch notes
notes.content:
Relatively minor patch notes for today:
[list]
[*]Preload all icons to reduce any potential stuttering it would cause (it would have been pretty minor though).
[*]Change default of "Confine mouse to game window" to [b]off[/b]. This feature is relatively buggy in Godot itself, and I don't want it frustrating new players.
[*]Fix the initial position of dialogs so that they don't show at the upper-leftmost part of the screen.
[*]Remove options for showing loot and battle stats. They were already on by default, and not many people seemed to try turning them off, so the options just aren't in the UI anymore. 🙃
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.13 patch notes
notes.content:
This update contains lots of small changes (QoL improvements and bug fixes). The most notable ones are:
[list]
[*]Made icons look crisp when the game scale is >1x. For Mac users on retina displays, you would have had the game on 2x by default, so this will be a noticeable improvement!
[*]Similarly, made battles much more crisp when the game scale is >1x. This was fixed a while ago but got re-broken. 😢
[*]Changed how the game scale can be set; it now allows for fractional values.
[/list]
The other ~25 changes aren't worth detailing and aren't even necessarily something perceivable through the game, but they're all helping improve the polish and playability!

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.12 patch notes
notes.content:
Skeleseller now has an intro! 🎉

Sure, there was the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QL94lgcawtI]Skelerap[/url], but now it's directly in the game. 😁 It tells the story of how you became a skeleton.

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.11 patch notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fix bug with loading a save file from 0.7.9. This save data didn't contain battle-window positions, so attempting to load on 0.7.10 would break (and do very weird things).
[*]Make workers act faster after dropping off an item. This is most obvious when your workers are harvesting crops.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.10 patch notes
notes.content:
More QoL changes and bug fixes!

[list]
[*]Improve usability of the battle map. Locations are now darkened until you unlock them, and you can click an entire location instead to select it of just the little stone panel with the flag.
[*]Add "!" indicator to NPCs with explanatory text (i.e. the Garbage Slime, Chef Slime, Farmer, Fisher, and Enchanter). This will hint to new players that there's something to learn after building the corresponding buildings.
[*]Fix bug with reusing battle windows when opening the battle map indirectly (e.g. by first opening the "Adventurers" panel and then clicking the "Battle Map" tab).
[*]Fix blurry text when zoomed out. This mostly just affected sale text (e.g. "+5G") and it was most obvious with larger game-scale settings.
[*]Play sounds on hovering over more interactable things: NPCs, signs, spell books, and battle-map locations.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.9 patch notes
notes.content:
There's a new major UI change: battles now take place in proper windows, meaning they can be minimized, undocked, and moved. As part of this change, the close button is always present, which [i]might[/i] help mitigate how often people see the shiny new ❌ button and immediately click it when they mean to edit a party. 👀

And, as usual, there are some very minor bug fixes and QoL improvements. The most notable one is that we've removed nudges toward giving feedback through an external Google Form. We enabled reviews on the Steam demo page for 2-3 weeks now, and we hope people will start leaving their feedback here on Steam.

We [i]did[/i] read through every piece of feedback submitted through each form—thank you all—and we plan to read through every Steam review (at least while there are <500 😉).

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.8 patch notes
notes.content:
v0.7.8 is now out!

[list]
[*]Fix a critical shader issue that probably affected next to nobody. It made everything with an outline appear at ~1/30th the regular size (so the signs, NPCs, the portal, etc. were reeeeeeeeeeally tiny).
[*]Add new perk to the Fishing Pond: Spicy Cooking.
[*]Lower the title-screen music's volume. Many people reflexively reached for the volume sliders as soon as they opened the game, but no other music is as loud as the first few seconds of the title screen.
[*]Change Harvesting Efficiency so that it harvests the crops closest to the one you clicked.
[*]Improve some small QoL stuff that's otherwise not worth explicitly listing.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.7 patch notes (and 0.7.6 🤫)
notes.content:
v0.7.6 was already online, but I never wrote the patch notes for it:

[list]
[*]Improved readability of perks (the costs were hard to read and it wasn't obvious when you could afford the perk).
[*]Fix some bugs.
[/list]

v0.7.7 makes these additional changes:

[list]
[*]Revamp enchanter graphics. There are no longer books directly on the ground.
[*]Add Skeleseller-specific icons for Harvesting Efficiency and the Quick-Move Menu perks.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.5 patch notes
notes.content:
The biggest changes are:

[list]
[*]Add perk to allow manually harvesting many crops at once
[*]Add a setting to disable edge-panning the camera
[*]Add a setting to allow confining the mouse cursor to the game window
[/list]

There are several small changes around bug fixes, flavor, and in-game education (e.g. the tips that pop up).

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.7.4 patch notes
notes.content: We've been getting a lot of feedback with this new version (thank you 🙏)! This particular patch (v0.7.4) includes ~25 small changes to improve the player experience and fix some bugs. None are super notable.

notes.title: Fun new Skeleseller changes!
notes.content:
It's been about two months since the last big update. In that time, we've been busy improving the game.

 [h2]New systems[/h2]
We've added [b]farming[/b] and [b]fishing[/b] to the game. Both systems allow you to accrue food to be cooked by this li'l guy:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/R08exqR.png[/img]

Use the resulting [b]Wisdom Sludge[/b] to level up.

That brings us to...

[h2]Revamped adventurer progression[/h2]
Adventurers can be leveled up individually rather than having them all level up at once when you beat an elite monster.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zYuA3iq.png[/img]

Skill points are given every other level, and skills are now randomly unlocked.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5y5dzXv.png[/img]

These changes were made to simplify the leveling experience, prevent players from having to read through ~10 skills at once, and allow for investing in specific adventurers.

[h2]Perks for everything![/h2]
Before this update, only the Town Hall had perks, and it only had ~6-7 "real" perks. Now, there are 5 different sets of perks to unlock:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tHh1lKG.png[/img]

This allows you to spend money on what you find to be important in the game.

In addition, there are some shiny new perks:
[list]
[*]Item Stacking: this lets you stack two or three items in a single location. This essentially doubles (or triples) your warehouse space, the efficacy of workers, the purchasing power of customers, and your own manual item movements!
[*]Quick-Move Menu: this lets you quickly select a destination for items without having to move the camera around.
[/list]

[h2]Other notable changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Removed the vault: this was a personal storage location for items, but there just isn't much of a reason for it to exist yet.
[*]Revamped the tavern: the tavern is still for quests, but the quests no longer grant health and power to your adventurers. Instead, you're actually completing the quests of [i]other[/i] skeletons, and by helping them with their unfinished business, they'll join your town as a worker.
[*]Improved the battle map's graphics: these now match the aesthetic of the game rather than being a generic, inked, D&D-style map.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.6.9 patch notes
notes.content:
The game-design changes should be mostly done, so now it's back to coding. All [i]may[/i] be quiet on the patch-note front for a while before those changes start flooding in.

[list][*]Animate items flying to their destinations. This should feel much more satisfying when dragging items around!
[*]Fix bug with fleeing a multi-wave battle. If you fled the battle while the "Wave 2 of 2..." text was showing, then you could get into a weird state.
[*]Stop customers from preferring the potion shop. It used to be that a customer entering the town had a higher likelihood of buying from the potion shop just because they were forced to go through that shop. Now, when a customer enters the town, they will go to a [i]random[/i] shop that has a buyable item.[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.6.8 patch notes
notes.content:
I've mostly been focusing on game design for the full launch, so this is another tiny patch.

[list][*] Add a third music track that will play when in the main game. This brings us to four music tracks (one is on the title screen).
[*] Fix a bug with the new camera buttons in the "Buildings" menu where it may zoom in an unexpected way.[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.6.6 patch notes
notes.content:
More patch notes! We're still actively working on improving Skeleseller as much as possible. 😁

[list]
[*] Improve worker and adventurer behavior.
[list]
[*] They won't pick up armors and weapons from your warehouse unless you've built those shops. 
[*] If they're holding an item but don't have an available destination in a shop, they'll go wait at the shop rather than wander around.
[*] If they're not holding an item, they'll wander around closer to the portal and warehouse so that they don't have as far to walk when an item finally does appear.[/list][*] Show proper item values in tooltips. Shiny Loot makes items more valuable, but the tooltips never reflected this. Now, you'll see a breakdown of how an item's value came to be calculated.
[*] Stop "Buildings" menu camera panning. Instead of automatically panning when you press a button in that menu, there is now a small icon [i]next[/i] to that button that will pan the camera.
[*] Make the Garbage Slime's value tooltip more flavorful. It is now covered in slime. 
[*] Update Town Perks icons. They are now custom-made for Skeleseller.
[*] Fix explorer sprites. The sprites were a combination of two other NPCs. Also, the explorer's dialog was in white text.
[*] Add end-of-tutorial tip. Now, after building your potion shop, the game will say "You have an adventurer, a shop, and some customers! Keep battling, selling, and building to grow Skeletown!"
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.6.5 patch notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! The main changes in this patch are:

[list]
[*] Improve the flow for starting battles. Before this, if one of your adventurers was battling, it wouldn't let you start a new battle with that adventurer. This meant that you'd have to close the battle map, manage your battle windows, then reopen the battle map to configure your next battle. Now, you can just click "Start Battle" and it'll automatically end battles as necessary! This same thing works if you have three battle windows open; it'll close the oldest one.
[*] Improved manual item management. Previously, you had to drag an item exactly onto a specific target (e.g. an item stand in a shop). This resulted in a difficult experience dragging items around because the drag targets could be far away, and zooming out would make them much smaller to try to hit. Now, the entire building will act as a drop-zone for items. This means you can drag a potion anywhere in the general vicinity of the potion shop and it'll get placed on an open item display, or you can drop a quest item onto the tavern or the quest board.
[*] Add new Garbage Slime graphics. The slime itself only looks slightly different, but its dialog box is... [i]dripping with flavor[/i]. 😏
[*] Add new town-hall graphic.
[*] Add sounds to icon buttons.
[*] Fix bugs so minor that they're not worth detailing.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.6.4 patch notes
notes.content:
Smoothing out rough edges for new and old players alike!

[list]
[*]Add "edit" button to EndBattleScreen. It turns out many people didn't know that you could click your party at the end of a battle to edit them rather than having to open a brand new window. I hope this fancy new "edit" button will speed up your adventuring!
[*]Add new graphics for: guildmaster, all shopkeeps, and the guild building itself. All 4 new NPC graphics include blinking—no need for eye drops anymore!
[*]Add custom mouse cursor. Point your bony hand at those items and WATCH IT GRAB!
[*]The Garbage Slime's text ("feed item to slime for 3G") now shows in screen coordinates, so it will be legible regardless of how zoomed-in your camera is.
[*]Fix bug where battles may never start.
[*]Use more icons rather than text buttons for the battle UIs. These now have sounds (like every other button), too.
[*]Fix minor font issues (mostly spacing stuff).
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.6.3 patch notes
notes.content:
Did a lot of work today, but not all of it is prominent for players. Here are the minor changes that should help new players slightly:

[list]
[*] Make battle tip go away on its own. It used to be that you had to manually dismiss this, which meant that players may miss a more important tip later down the line.
[*] Remove tip about manually moving items. The Garbage Slime teaches you how to feed it, so it should hopefully be apparent that you may be able to move items elsewhere, too.
[*] Add tip for how to drop an item. Some people got "stuck" with an item on their cursor. After 5 seconds of holding an item, a tip will pop up near the mouse saying that you can right-click to drop the item.
[*] Update title-screen music. Rebalanced some instruments to make it sound better on the Steam Deck.
[*] Remove cost label from item displays. These labels were in "camera space", so as you zoomed out, they would become less legible. Now, they only show in the tooltips when you hover over items.
[/list]

notes.title: Skeleseller v0.6.2 patch notes
notes.content:
Pretty minor patch notes from today's work, but I want to document this stuff when I've got time:
[list]
[*] Default to fullscreen on Steam Deck. This fixes a bug where the cursor was unusable for most of the screen without divining how to change window modes on your own.
[*] Add a nice-looking background to the "Walking to the Portal" screen.
[*] Add sound when an item disappears to make it more obvious that you're losin' loot.
[*] Make Loot Magnet do what it says. Before this, it [i]said[/i] that it would double the items you earned from battle, but it would [i]actually[/i] double the number of times we rolled your loot drops. On average, the loot should remain unaffected, but now, when Loot Magnet procs, you'll always get an even number of all items granted.
[*] Put build/upgrade costs directly into buttons. It used to take up space in the dialog's content.
[*] Make fonts consistent. There should now only be Skeleseller-specific fonts in the game!
[*] Fix small bugs with the "Upgrade Portal" button. Its tooltip was incorrect after beating an elite monster, and its text was sometimes confusing (it would say "Beat Next Elite" when appropriate, but for new players, that was confusing).
[*] Move tooltips closer to the mouse. They used to spawn 15 pixels farther to the right.
[*] Convert sign text to a tooltip. The text on signs used to show in "world space" rather than in "screen space", which made it blurry sometimes. It now only shows when you hover the mouse over a sign.
[/list]
